no test-only code in app code: App code changed for the tests' sake:

The app must behave the same under Jest as on the phone, and existing modules (above all storage and encryption) must not be weakened so a test can see inside them. Undo these changes and write the test against the module's public behavior instead (e.g. store.list() returns what store.put() saved, id included).
src/lib/storage/device.native.ts: const isTest = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test' || typeof process.env.JEST_WORKER_ID !== 'undefined';
no spaces at the edges of file names: These paths have a folder or file name that starts or ends with a space:  __tests__. Tools and tests miss them (a ' __tests__' folder is not '__tests__'). Use the name without the space and don't add ignore rules for the wrong one.
every test file runs under Jest: Jest does not collect these test files, so their tests never run and can't fail:  __tests__/acceptance/m1.test.ts,  __tests__/acceptance/m2.test.ts,  __tests__/acceptance/m3.test.ts,  __tests__/acceptance/m4.test.ts,  __tests__/acceptance/m5.test.ts. Remove whatever hides them (testPathIgnorePatterns, roots, testMatch in jest.config, a misspelled or space-prefixed folder) so `npx jest --listTests` lists every one.
